memory: I measured S_ring(torque) on the ring alone and S_total with pad in place at torques 0.2–2.4 N·m; inked a fell 5.5→4.3 mm. Subtraction S_pad = S_total−S_ring gives S_pad(a) with RMS error ≈6.8% against my prior no‑clamp S(a). The ring calibration removes bulk clamp stiffness but misses clamp↔pad geometric coupling (bulge, edge flattening). Target ≤5% not met. Standing correction: ring‑only data must be depth/geometry resolved or paired with a surrogate pad to capture coupling. Next action: map S_clamp(torque, indentation depth) using depth‑resolved ring calibrations.
openQuestion: Will depth‑resolved ring calibrations (multiple indentation depths) plus inked a reduce RMS error of recovered S_pad(a) to ≤5%?
